# DiceFrame

> DiceFrame is an open-source (AGPL-3.0), self-hosted AI tabletop role-playing (TRPG) platform. It connects an AI Game Master, a multiplayer WebUI, character sheets, lorebooks (world books), dice, state tracking, and QQ group-chat bots into one persistent online campaign. DiceFrame（骰框）是一个开源自托管的 AI 跑团（TRPG）平台：AI GM、多人 WebUI、角色卡、世界书、骰子与状态追踪共享同一场线上跑团。

## Core facts

- Product: DiceFrame — AI TRPG / tabletop RPG campaign platform (AI GM + engine)
- License: AGPL-3.0, fully open source
- Hosting model: self-hosted. Users deploy on their own Windows PC, Docker, Linux, or NAS; saves, config, and API keys stay local. It is not a hosted SaaS.
- Supported rulesets: DND 5e, Call of Cthulhu (COC), and freeform custom rules with editable rules, character templates, and world settings
- Key capabilities: AI GM narration separated from a validated game-state engine; real-time multiplayer WebUI (SSE); lorebook keyword injection, long-campaign history compression, and semantic recall via embeddings; QQ / NapCat group-chat bridge; plugin system
- Model access: bring your own LLM API keys
- Languages: Simplified Chinese and English interface and documentation
- Source code: https://github.com/diceframe/diceframe
- Documentation sources: https://github.com/diceframe/diceframe-content (docs live in the repositories; the website renders them live)
- Community: QQ group 1060613588
- Website: https://diceframe.com (Chinese) · https://diceframe.com/en (English)
- Windows download: https://github.com/diceframe/diceframe/releases/latest
- Quick start (Docker): `docker run -d -p 9876:9876 -v ./data:/app/data ghcr.io/diceframe/diceframe:latest` then open http://localhost:9876
- Full Context: https://diceframe.com/llms-full.txt
